I knew someday they would come back.''"<br />[whispering] "''But, Captain Piard&mdash;aren't the Jedi the ''enemies'' of the Empire?''"<br />"''Well, ''these'' Jedi are our ''very'' welcomed ''friends'', Guerno!''"<br />[whispering] "''Yes, Captain!|Captain Piard and Guerno, regarding Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
'''Guerno''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], the [[Piard's shipping vessel|shipping vessel]] on which Guerno and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Piard]] were stationed was [[Black Sun pirate raid|raided]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who demanded their shipment of [[M-40 light repeating blaster|Thunderbolt Mark 7 blasters]]. Guerno and Piard were rescued by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]], who used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince them that Black Sun pirates stole the cargo. Skywalker and his companions, [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]], then took the shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You. Guerno. Bind up these Black Sun gornts.|Cade Skywalker to Guerno|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
[[File:Guernoandcade.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Guerno encounters Cade Skywalker.]]
Guerno was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] in [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] between [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] Empire and deposed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]]. Guerno served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Piard]] aboard an [[Piard's shipping vessel|Imperial shipping vessel]] that was delivering a cargo of [[M-40 light repeating blaster|Thunderbolt Mark 7 blasters]] via the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]].<ref name="Legacy 37" />

Piard's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] stopped at the [[5709-DC Shipping Lane]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], and was [[Black Sun pirate raid|boarded]] by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] affiliated with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Guerno and Piard were threatened by the pirates' [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] captain, [[Dovrin]], who demanded to know where the [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were. The Cathar was interrupted by hearing a noise nearby and sent some cronies to investigate. Shortly thereafter, the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and his companions, [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]], revealed themselves after boarding and rescued Guerno and Piard by [[Death/Legends|killing]] Dovrin and neutralizing the remaining pirates.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

As Piard thanked Skywalker, Guerno was perplexed by the captain's words since the Jedi were enemies of the Empire, but the Captain's voice raised to insist that Skywalker was not a threat; Guerno took the hint. After Skywalker gave [[Binders/Legends|binders]] to Guerno to detain the disabled pirates, both Imperials were [[Mind trick/Legends|influenced]] by a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] from Skywalker to believe that the Black Sun pirates took their cargo and to forget the encounter. Skywalker and his companions then took the blasters.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

==Personality and traits==
Guerno had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown skin, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. On duty, Guerno wore the [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]] of an Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. When Piard showed gratitude to Skywalker, Guerno initially questioned it but did not press the issue when Piard insisted that Skywalker and his companions were friends. Guerno was susceptible to the influence of Skywalker's mind trick.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

==Behind the scenes==
Guerno appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 37|thirty-seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="Legacy 37" /> and released on [[June 24]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54409/star_wars_legacy_2006_37|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #37}}</ref>
